guide.summary: A spiral sugar eater that grows best in salty water.
guide.biology: Some microbes live in salty ponds and marshes, where many other microbes struggle to grow.
guide.rules: Lives in water and gel. Eats sugar using oxygen. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food up to 2 cells away. Grows best at salinity 0.4 to 0.8; it weakens as salinity falls toward 0.2 and cannot feed at 0.2 or below, so it needs added salt. Rampart's rivalry chemical harms it.
guide.example: Add salt to one side of the dish and Brinecoils to both sides, and compare where they thrive.
